    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

# Workflow authoring reference

A workflow structures work across many agents — to be comprehensive (decompose and cover in parallel), to be confident (independent perspectives and adversarial checks before committing), or to take on scale one context can't hold (migrations, audits, broad sweeps). The script is where you encode that structure: what fans out, what verifies, what synthesizes.

When you do call it, the right move is often **hybrid**: scout inline first (list the files, find the channels, scope the diff) to discover the work-list, then call Workflow to pipeline over it. You don't need to know the shape before the *task* — only before the *orchestration step*.

Common single-phase workflows you can chain across turns:
- **Understand** — parallel readers over relevant subsystems → structured map
- **Design** — judge panel of N independent approaches → scored synthesis
- **Review** — dimensions → find → adversarially verify (the review-changes example)
- **Research** — multi-modal sweep → deep-read → synthesize
- **Migrate** — discover sites → transform each (worktree isolation) → verify

For larger work, run several in sequence — read each result before deciding the next phase. You stay in the loop; each workflow is one well-scoped fan-out.

**Ultracode.** When a system-reminder confirms ultracode is on, that opt-in is standing: author and run a workflow for every substantive task by default. The goal is the most exhaustive, correct answer you can produce — token cost is not a constraint. For multi-phase work (understand → design → implement → review), that often means several workflows in sequence — one per phase — so you stay in the loop between them. The quality patterns below (adversarial verify, multi-modal sweep, completeness critic, loop-until-dry) are the tools; pick what fits the task. Lean toward orchestrating with workflows and adversarially verifying your findings — unless the work is trivial or already verified. Solo only on conversational turns or trivial mechanical edits. When a reminder says ultracode is off, revert to the opt-in rule in the Workflow tool description.

Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first. Every invocation automatically persists its script to a file under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate on a workflow, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with `{scriptPath: "<path>"}` instead of resending the full script.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'find-flaky-tests',
    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group. Add `model` to a phase entry when that phase uses a specific model override.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, model?: string, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

1	# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端
2	
3	一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
4	密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
5	操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。HTTP 信封加密、
6	轮换/导入/恢复是幂等操作：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程
7	在任一步骤崩溃后重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。
8	（CLI `encrypt` 保持旧的非幂等行为，不携带 `Idempotency-Key`。）私钥只保存
9	在服务端，任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。
10	
11	## 依赖与安装
12	
13	Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：
14	
15	```bash
16	pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
17	```
18	
19	## 启动
20	
21	```bash
22	python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
23	```
24	
25	数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
26	提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
27	`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。也可用
28	`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 配置主备链：逗号分隔的 `local`/`module:factory`
29	项，项与项建厂所得的 `provider_id` 都必须唯一；未设时沿用
30	`KEYMGR_PROVIDER`，设为空、含空项或格式错误的链一律不可用（固定
31	`503`/CLI `1`）。链的初选、故障转移与状态提交见下。
32	
33	## 基础测试
34	
35	```bash
36	python -m compileall -q keymgr
37	python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
38	curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
39	  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
40	  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
41	```
42	
43	## 通用约定
44	
45	- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
46	  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
47	  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
48	- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
49	  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
50	  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
51	  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
52	- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
53	  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
54	  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
55	- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
56	  不泄露存在性。
57	
58	## HTTP 接口
59	
60	- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
61	  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
62	  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
63	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
64	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
65	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
66	  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
67	- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
68	  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
69	  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
70	  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
71	  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
72	  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
73	  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
74	  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
75	  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
76	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
77	  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
78	  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
79	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
80	  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
81	  首次值。
82	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
83	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
84	  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
85	  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
86	- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
87	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
88	  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
89	  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
90	  幂等键。
91	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/encrypt`，需单一 `Idempotency-Key` 头，body
92	  `{tenant_id, version?, plaintext, aad?}`；`plaintext`、`aad` 为 base64，
93	  `version` 缺省为 current。幂等键先于请求体与一切业务校验：缺失/为空/重复/
94	  非法一律 `400`，绑定前的参数/解析错误也是无副作用 `400`（不写审计、操作
95	  记录或句柄）。绑定即生成 UUID4 `operation_id`；同键同规范化请求重放首次
96	  状态码、信封与审计（同一 `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次），同键异请求
97	  `409` 并在错误体给出原 `operation_id`。成功 `200`，键序固定
98	  `{"format","envelope","operation_id"}`：`format` 固定
99	  `keymgr-envelope-v1`、`envelope` 为 base64、`operation_id` 为本次操作；
100	  内含 key_id、version、算法、nonce/tag、密文及**包装后的数据密钥**：每次
101	  新绑定生成新的 256 位数据密钥，以 AES-256-GCM 加密明文；AES256 版本用
102	  AES-GCM 包装数据密钥，RSA2048 版本用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 包装（重放返回首次
103	  信封，不再生成新数据密钥、不再调用提供者）。绑定后错误体仅
104	  `{"error","operation_id"}`：授权拒绝 `403`、未知/跨租户 key 或未知版本
105	  `404`、吊销版本（含旧版本）`409`、提供者不可用 `503`（文案固定
106	  `key management provider is unavailable`）；等待同 key 锁超过 5 秒为
107	  `503` timed_out（等待方不写任何东西）。事件耐久前崩溃保持 `pending` 且
108	  对 `GET operation` 隐藏 http_status/response（含信封），同键重启或重试在
109	  同一 `operation_id` 下恰好再执行一次并原样重放；事件耐久后严格重放首次
110	  结果。绑定只持久化明文/AAD 的不透明键控承诺，明文、AAD、数据/私钥、句柄
111	  与后端异常绝不进入响应、审计或任何文件。
112	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/decrypt`，body `{tenant_id, envelope, aad?}`，接
113	  受 `keymgr-envelope-v1`。`200` → `{plaintext}`（base64）。信封内 key_id
114	  必须与路径一致；缺字段、非法 base64、篡改、AAD 不符为 `400` 且错误指明
115	  字段；未知或跨租户的 key/version 为 `404`；吊销版本（含旧版本）为 `409`；
116	  提供者不可用为 `503`，沿用固定脱敏文案。私钥、数据密钥只存在于进程内存，
117	  绝不进入响应或审计。

120	  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。

136	## KMS/HSM 健康检查与无中断重连
137	
138	- `GET /v1/provider/status`：只需单一非空 `X-Operator-Id`，不收
139	  `tenant_id`（头/查询/体均不接受，违者 `400`），也不记审计。返回 `200`，
140	  键序固定 `{"provider_id","status"}`；`status` 仅 `ready`/`unavailable`。
141	  提供者尚未加载时该探测会惰性建厂；加载/契约/配置失败时
142	  `provider_id` 为 `null`、`status` 为 `unavailable`，后端异常文本绝不外泄。
143	- 提供者可选实现 `health()`：无参数、返回 `bool`。缺少该方法视为健康；
144	  返回非 `bool`（即使为真值）或抛异常均视为不可用，文本不外泄。
145	- `POST /v1/provider/reconnect`：同样只需单一非空操作者头、不收
146	  `tenant_id`。请求体必须恰为 `{}`：坏 JSON、非对象或任何多余字段一律
147	  无副作用 `400`。按当前 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER`/`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 配置
148	  重新建厂（链配置时按链序重选**首个健康项**，这是唯一可能切回已恢复
149	  主项的操作）、校验契约、用已绑定的数据目录配置并做健康检查，成功才替
150	  换实例并 `200` 返回与 status 同序结构；任一失败（排水/建厂/配置/健康
151	  超过共用 5 秒门限）都 `503` 且保留旧实例，错误体固定
152	  `{"error":"key management provider is unavailable"}`。
153	- **共用 5 秒门限、无中断**：重连与提供者调用共用 5 秒门限。重连先排水：
154	  在途调用由其进入时捕获的旧实例完成，绝不中途换实例；新调用在门内等待，
155	  等待超 5 秒返回固定 `503` 且零副作用（未调用任何提供者、未铸句柄、未写
156	  审计）。重连成功后新调用一律落到新实例。
157	- **pending 操作绑定原 provider_id**：幂等操作记录其提供者 `provider_id`。
158	  重连装入的提供者 `provider_id` 不同而某 pending 操作仍绑定旧 id 时，该
159	  操作保持 `pending` 并返回固定 `503`（不终态化、不写拒绝事件、镜像复位为
160	  干净的 `bound` 待续线索）；重连同 `provider_id` 的提供者后，同
161	  `Idempotency-Key` 的请求在**同一** `operation_id`/`event_id` 下继续恰好
162	  一次，事件绝不重复。从未在本数据目录激活过的 provider_id 仍按原“未激活
163	  提供者”规则终态 `503`。曾激活的 provider_id 记在
164	  `provider-ids.json`(0600)，跨进程可识别。
165	- **主备故障转移（`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN`）**：链配置后，首次健康激活
166	  选链中首个健康项。每次提供者调用都会探测活动实例；活动实例不健康时，
167	  复用同一 5 秒跨进程意图/排水门切到首个健康备项（排除当前活动 id）：
168	  在途旧调用由其进入时捕获的实例完成，切换提交后到达的调用只用新代，
169	  并发触发仅一次建厂/提交（其余等待者直接采用已提交的代）。切换失败
170	  （无健康备项、门限超时、提交失败）不改旧代，固定 `503`（CLI `1`），
171	  不铸句柄、不写审计、不外泄后端文本。主项恢复健康后**不自动回切**；
172	  只有 reconnect 按链序重选首个健康项。pending 幂等操作仍绑定原
173	  `provider_id`，绝不在备端重放；重连回同 id 提供者后，同
174	  `Idempotency-Key` 的请求在同一 `operation_id`/`event_id` 下继续恰好
175	  一次。
176	- **定向切换（`POST /v1/provider/switchover`）**：只需单一非空
177	  `X-Operator-Id`，不收 `tenant_id`（头/查询/体均 `400`），不记审计。
178	  请求体严格为 `{"provider_id": P}`（P 非空）：坏 JSON、非对象、缺
179	  字段、空值或任何多余字段均无副作用 `400` 并指出字段；未配置
180	  `KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 或 P 不在链中同样 `400` 指出 `provider_id`
181	  且零副作用。P 即当前活动项时：健康则 `200` 且代不变，否则固定
182	  `503`。目标建厂/契约/健康检查失败或共用 5 秒门限耗尽均固定 `503`
183	  （体 `{"error":"key management provider is unavailable"}`）且零副作
184	  用。成功复用同一跨进程意图/排水门：在途旧调用由其捕获的实例完成，
185	  后到调用等待；先原子写 `switching`（旧 ID、P、原代、reason
186	  `reconnect`），再写 `ready`（P、null、代+1）；同目标并发切换只提交
187	  一次；写间崩溃仅在 P 健康时完成该切换，否则保留 `switching` 并
188	  `503`。`200` 键序固定 `provider_id,status`，值为 P、`ready`。
189	  pending 幂等操作仍绑定原 `provider_id`。
190	- **跨进程激活状态 `provider-state.json`(0600)**：首次健康激活、每次成功
191	  重连与每次主备切换都原子提交（temp 文件 fsync 后 rename）该文件：紧凑
192	  UTF-8 JSON、非 ASCII 原样、无末尾换行，键序固定
193	  `schema_version,provider_id,target_provider_id,generation,reason,phase`
194	  （依次为固定整数 2、非空字符串、null/非空字符串、从 1 递增的正整数、
195	  `initial`/`reconnect`/`failover`、`ready`/`switching`）；旧
196	  schema_version 1 文件（仅 `schema_version,provider_id,generation`
197	  三字段）视作 `ready`。切换（故障转移
198	  或改换 provider_id 的重连）先原子写 `switching`（旧 ID、目标 ID、原
199	  代），再写 `ready`（目标 ID、null、代+1）；重启或任一进程读到
200	  `switching` 时重验目标：健康即完成该切换（写 `ready`、代+1），否则保
201	  留文件原样并固定 `503`。文件缺失由首次健康激活创建（generation 1）；
202	  损坏或字段非法时，提供者调用与重连一律按固定文案 `503` 且绝不改写该
203	  文件。仅健康候选能在跨进程排他锁（`provider-state.lock`，与进程内门
204	  共用 5 秒门限）下互斥递增 generation；失败或提交前崩溃保留旧代。提交
205	  后各进程下次调用重建当前配置，所得 `provider_id` 不符或不健康则
206	  `503`（链配置时改为触发故障转移）且零副作用。
207	- CLI：`provider status --operator O`、
208	  `provider reconnect --operator O` 与
209	  `provider switchover --operator O --provider-id P`，成功输出同序单行
210	  JSON；`400→2`、`503→1`，成功 `0`。status 在提供者不可用时仍以退出
211	  `0` 返回 `{"provider_id":null,"status":"unavailable"}`。

213	## 幂等操作
214	
215	- HTTP 的 rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate/encrypt（CLI：
216	  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`；CLI `encrypt` 维持非幂等、
217	  无此头）必须携带**单一** `Idempotency-Key` 头（前四个 CLI 必填
218	  `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个 `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、
219	  重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写
220	  审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
221	- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
222	  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
223	  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
224	  排他锁串行化。encrypt 的规范化体对明文/AAD 只保存键控不透明承诺，绝不保存
225	  明文或 AAD 本身。
226	- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
227	  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
228	  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
229	  不占用该键。
230	- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。变更类成功为
231	  `201` succeeded，只读 encrypt 成功为 `200` succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409`
232	  conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为 failed（保留原状态码）。并发
233	  同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回 `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待
234	  方不写任何东西。
235	- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
236	  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
237	  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
238	  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
239	- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
240	  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
241	- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
242	  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
243	  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原
244	  `200`/`201`/`403`/`404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随
245	  事件持久化，严格重放）；变更类操作事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文
246	  件、提供者句柄与标记由 outbox/provision 恢复回滚；只读 encrypt 事件未入帐
247	  时保持 `pending`（信封无法在无请求的情况下重建，故绝不臆造终态），由同键
248	  HTTP 重试在同一 `operation_id` 下恰好再执行一次。不重复记账（账本按
249	  event_id 去重），不误判。
250	- **operation 工件镜像**：rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 以及 HTTP
251	  encrypt 在幂等键绑定记录耐久**之后**、首次调用提供者**之前**，原子创建
252	  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`（0600、temp 文件 fsync 后 rename；
253	  非幂等入口与未绑定请求不创建该目录；CLI `encrypt` 为非幂等入口不创建）。
254	  镜像是一次尝试全部耐久工件的交叉索引，记录租户、操作者、路径、规范化请求
255	  体、`kind`/审计动作、完整写集（rotate/import/encrypt 为该 key_id，batch
256	  为全部 key_id，restore 为全部新建 key_id 及是否含策略）、阶段
257	  （`bound`→`provisioning`→`staged`→`committed`/`rolled_back`）、
258	  `provisions/<id>.json` 引用（batch 另引用 `batch-rotations/<id>.json`，空
259	  restore 另记录其 `restore-empty-*` 标记）以及每铸一个句柄即登记的新句柄
260	  `provider_id`/`handle`；只读 encrypt 不铸句柄、无 journal/snapshot，镜像始
261	  终停在 `bound`，事件耐久且无残留证据即清除。镜像与 journal 条目同步落盘，
262	  二者永不矛盾。请求到达终态后：事件确认且 action/tenant/operation 一致、写
263	  集文件拥有全部新句柄且 journal/snapshot 已清，才删镜像并保留新版本（encrypt
264	  另核对暂存信封命名写集 key 且版本存在）；事件未入账时，变更类先由 outbox
265	  恢复幂等删除全部新句柄并恢复可信旧写集，证据清零才删镜像；encrypt 则保持
266	  pending 并保留镜像作为待重试线索。账本不可读、提交不确定（同 id 事件
267	  action/tenant 不符）、镜像缺失/损坏、镜像与 `operations/<id>.json` 绑定不
268	  一致、引用缺失/不一致或 batch snapshot 损坏时，**保留整组证据**（镜像、标
269	  记、journal、snapshot 与句柄），不猜测回滚也不暴露未提交 current：该
270	  operation 保持 `pending`，请求/重启返回 `500`/`503` 等待下次重试。无镜像的
271	  旧 journal 与旧 restore 标记沿用原有恢复规则，镜像从不强制存在。
272	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
273	  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
274	  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
275	  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。

277	## 策略
278	
279	- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
280	  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
281	  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
282	  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
283	- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
284	  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
285	  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/encrypt/decrypt/audit`，单条内
286	  重复去重；`effect` 为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同
287	  subject+effect+无序动作集的重复规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
288	- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
289	  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
290	  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
291	  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。
292	
293	## 审计
294	
295	- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
296	  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/
297	  encrypt/decrypt/audit/tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/
298	  policy_delete`，`outcome` 为 `success/rejected`。信封加密/解密事件只含
299	  元数据（无 plaintext、aad、envelope、数据密钥或私钥）；幂等 HTTP encrypt
300	  每个终态至多一条 `event_id=operation_id,action=encrypt` 事件（成功 200 与
301	  绑定后拒绝都随操作重放，绝不重复记账），非幂等 CLI/decrypt 每次请求各记一
302	  条；策略拒绝写一条对应 `encrypt`/`decrypt` 的 rejected 事件（携带 key_id），
303	  成功写对应 action 的 success 事件。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者
304	  `key_id` 均为 null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批
305	  至多一条 `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
306	  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
307	- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
308	  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
309	  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
310	  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
311	  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
312	- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
313	  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
314	  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
315	  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
316	  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
317	  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
318	  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
319	  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。
320	
321	## 命令行
322	
323	所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
324	单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。
325	
326	```bash
327	# 密钥
328	python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
329	python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
330	python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
331	python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
332	python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
333	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
334	python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
335	                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
336	                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
337	python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
338	python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
339	# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
340	python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
341	# 信封加密/解密（plaintext/aad 为 base64，version 缺省 current）
342	python -m keymgr encrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
343	                          --plaintext <base64> [--aad <base64>] [--version 1] \
344	                          --operator alice
345	python -m keymgr decrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
346	                          --envelope <keymgr-envelope-v1-base64> [--aad <base64>] \
347	                          --operator alice
348	python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
349	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
350	python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
351	python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
352	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
353	# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
354	python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
355	python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
356	python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
357	# KMS/HSM 健康检查与无中断重连（全局，无 --tenant-id）
358	python -m keymgr provider status    --operator alice
359	python -m keymgr provider reconnect --operator alice
360	```
361	
362	## KMS/HSM 提供者
363	
364	- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
365	  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
366	  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
367	  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
368	  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
369	  幂等。另可实现可选 `health()`（无参、返回 `bool`）：缺少视为健康，非
370	  `bool`/抛异常视为不可用。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`
371	  （CLI `1`），固定文案
372	  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
373	  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
374	- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
375	  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
376	  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
377	  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
378	- `KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 为主备链：逗号分隔的 `local`/`module:factory`
379	  项，项唯一且建厂所得 `provider_id` 唯一（重复即整链不可用）。首次激活
380	  选首个健康项；活动实例不健康时按上节规则故障转移到首个健康备项，主项
381	  恢复后不自动回切，reconnect 才按链序重选。链配置时“本地提供者是否活
382	  动”以已提交的 `provider-state.json` 为准（`provider_id` 为 `local`），
383	  旧记录接管等门控不会因此导入任何 module:factory 提供者。
384	- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
385	  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
386	- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
387	  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
388	  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
389	  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。
390	
391	## 持久化与限制
392	
393	- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
394	  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
395	  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
396	- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal
397	  （首行耐久记录 operation_id、租户与动作，每铸一个句柄即以 0600 原子重写登记
398	  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
399	  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复
400	  依据 journal 头校验账本中同 id 事件确属本次操作（动作、租户一致）才判定已
401	  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量
402	  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
403	  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
404	  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
405	- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
406	  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
407	  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
408	- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
409	  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。
410	- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 另有 0600 的 operation 工件镜像
411	  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`：绑定后、调用提供者前创建，交叉
412	  关联 `operations/<id>.json`、`provisions/<id>.json`、restore 标记（含空
413	  restore 标记）或 batch snapshot，记录租户/操作者/路径/规范请求/动作/写集/
414	  阶段及新句柄；确认提交并核对句柄归属后随 journal/snapshot 一并清理，未提交
415	  时待全部新句柄删除、旧写集恢复后清理，任何证据缺失或不一致则整组保留（详见
416	  “幂等操作”一节）。
417

# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端

一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。HTTP 信封加密、
轮换/导入/恢复是幂等操作：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程
在任一步骤崩溃后重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。
（CLI `encrypt` 保持旧的非幂等行为，不携带 `Idempotency-Key`。）私钥只保存
在服务端，任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。

## 依赖与安装

Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
```

## 启动

```bash
python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。也可用
`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 配置主备链：逗号分隔的 `local`/`module:factory`
项，项与项建厂所得的 `provider_id` 都必须唯一；未设时沿用
`KEYMGR_PROVIDER`，设为空、含空项或格式错误的链一律不可用（固定
`503`/CLI `1`）。链的初选、故障转移与状态提交见下。

## 基础测试

```bash
python -m compileall -q keymgr
python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
```

## 通用约定

- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
  不泄露存在性。

## HTTP 接口

- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
  首次值。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
  幂等键。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/encrypt`，需单一 `Idempotency-Key` 头，body
  `{tenant_id, version?, plaintext, aad?}`；`plaintext`、`aad` 为 base64，
  `version` 缺省为 current。幂等键先于请求体与一切业务校验：缺失/为空/重复/
  非法一律 `400`，绑定前的参数/解析错误也是无副作用 `400`（不写审计、操作
  记录或句柄）。绑定即生成 UUID4 `operation_id`；同键同规范化请求重放首次
  状态码、信封与审计（同一 `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次），同键异请求
  `409` 并在错误体给出原 `operation_id`。成功 `200`，键序固定
  `{"format","envelope","operation_id"}`：`format` 固定
  `keymgr-envelope-v1`、`envelope` 为 base64、`operation_id` 为本次操作；
  内含 key_id、version、算法、nonce/tag、密文及**包装后的数据密钥**：每次
  新绑定生成新的 256 位数据密钥，以 AES-256-GCM 加密明文；AES256 版本用
  AES-GCM 包装数据密钥，RSA2048 版本用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 包装（重放返回首次
  信封，不再生成新数据密钥、不再调用提供者）。绑定后错误体仅
  `{"error","operation_id"}`：授权拒绝 `403`、未知/跨租户 key 或未知版本
  `404`、吊销版本（含旧版本）`409`、提供者不可用 `503`（文案固定
  `key management provider is unavailable`）；等待同 key 锁超过 5 秒为
  `503` timed_out（等待方不写任何东西）。事件耐久前崩溃保持 `pending` 且
  对 `GET operation` 隐藏 http_status/response（含信封），同键重启或重试在
  同一 `operation_id` 下恰好再执行一次并原样重放；事件耐久后严格重放首次
  结果。绑定只持久化明文/AAD 的不透明键控承诺，明文、AAD、数据/私钥、句柄
  与后端异常绝不进入响应、审计或任何文件。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/decrypt`，body `{tenant_id, envelope, aad?}`，接
  受 `keymgr-envelope-v1`。`200` → `{plaintext}`（base64）。信封内 key_id
  必须与路径一致；缺字段、非法 base64、篡改、AAD 不符为 `400` 且错误指明
  字段；未知或跨租户的 key/version 为 `404`；吊销版本（含旧版本）为 `409`；
  提供者不可用为 `503`，沿用固定脱敏文案。私钥、数据密钥只存在于进程内存，
  绝不进入响应或审计。
- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
  租户策略，见下。
- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。
- `GET /v1/provider/status` 与 `POST /v1/provider/reconnect`：KMS/HSM
  健康检查与无中断重连，见下（全局、非租户作用域，不带也不接受
  `tenant_id`，不记审计）。
- `POST /v1/provider/switchover`：主备链定向切换，见下（同样全局、非
  租户作用域，不记审计）。

## KMS/HSM 健康检查与无中断重连

- `GET /v1/provider/status`：只需单一非空 `X-Operator-Id`，不收
  `tenant_id`（头/查询/体均不接受，违者 `400`），也不记审计。返回 `200`，
  键序固定 `{"provider_id","status"}`；`status` 仅 `ready`/`unavailable`。
  提供者尚未加载时该探测会惰性建厂；加载/契约/配置失败时
  `provider_id` 为 `null`、`status` 为 `unavailable`，后端异常文本绝不外泄。
- 提供者可选实现 `health()`：无参数、返回 `bool`。缺少该方法视为健康；
  返回非 `bool`（即使为真值）或抛异常均视为不可用，文本不外泄。
- `POST /v1/provider/reconnect`：同样只需单一非空操作者头、不收
  `tenant_id`。请求体必须恰为 `{}`：坏 JSON、非对象或任何多余字段一律
  无副作用 `400`。按当前 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER`/`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 配置
  重新建厂（链配置时按链序重选**首个健康项**，这是唯一可能切回已恢复
  主项的操作）、校验契约、用已绑定的数据目录配置并做健康检查，成功才替
  换实例并 `200` 返回与 status 同序结构；任一失败（排水/建厂/配置/健康
  超过共用 5 秒门限）都 `503` 且保留旧实例，错误体固定
  `{"error":"key management provider is unavailable"}`。
- **共用 5 秒门限、无中断**：重连与提供者调用共用 5 秒门限。重连先排水：
  在途调用由其进入时捕获的旧实例完成，绝不中途换实例；新调用在门内等待，
  等待超 5 秒返回固定 `503` 且零副作用（未调用任何提供者、未铸句柄、未写
  审计）。重连成功后新调用一律落到新实例。
- **pending 操作绑定原 provider_id**：幂等操作记录其提供者 `provider_id`。
  重连装入的提供者 `provider_id` 不同而某 pending 操作仍绑定旧 id 时，该
  操作保持 `pending` 并返回固定 `503`（不终态化、不写拒绝事件、镜像复位为
  干净的 `bound` 待续线索）；重连同 `provider_id` 的提供者后，同
  `Idempotency-Key` 的请求在**同一** `operation_id`/`event_id` 下继续恰好
  一次，事件绝不重复。从未在本数据目录激活过的 provider_id 仍按原“未激活
  提供者”规则终态 `503`。曾激活的 provider_id 记在
  `provider-ids.json`(0600)，跨进程可识别。
- **主备故障转移（`KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN`）**：链配置后，首次健康激活
  选链中首个健康项。每次提供者调用都会探测活动实例；活动实例不健康时，
  复用同一 5 秒跨进程意图/排水门切到首个健康备项（排除当前活动 id）：
  在途旧调用由其进入时捕获的实例完成，切换提交后到达的调用只用新代，
  并发触发仅一次建厂/提交（其余等待者直接采用已提交的代）。切换失败
  （无健康备项、门限超时、提交失败）不改旧代，固定 `503`（CLI `1`），
  不铸句柄、不写审计、不外泄后端文本。主项恢复健康后**不自动回切**；
  只有 reconnect 按链序重选首个健康项。pending 幂等操作仍绑定原
  `provider_id`，绝不在备端重放；重连回同 id 提供者后，同
  `Idempotency-Key` 的请求在同一 `operation_id`/`event_id` 下继续恰好
  一次。
- **定向切换（`POST /v1/provider/switchover`）**：只需单一非空
  `X-Operator-Id`，不收 `tenant_id`（头/查询/体均 `400`），不记审计。
  请求体严格为 `{"provider_id": P}`（P 非空）：坏 JSON、非对象、缺
  字段、空值或任何多余字段均无副作用 `400` 并指出字段；未配置
  `KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 或 P 不在链中同样 `400` 指出 `provider_id`
  且零副作用。P 即当前活动项时：健康则 `200` 且代不变，否则固定
  `503`。目标建厂/契约/健康检查失败或共用 5 秒门限耗尽均固定 `503`
  （体 `{"error":"key management provider is unavailable"}`）且零副作
  用。成功复用同一跨进程意图/排水门：在途旧调用由其捕获的实例完成，
  后到调用等待；先原子写 `switching`（旧 ID、P、原代、reason
  `reconnect`），再写 `ready`（P、null、代+1）；同目标并发切换只提交
  一次；写间崩溃仅在 P 健康时完成该切换，否则保留 `switching` 并
  `503`。`200` 键序固定 `provider_id,status`，值为 P、`ready`。
  pending 幂等操作仍绑定原 `provider_id`。
- **跨进程激活状态 `provider-state.json`(0600)**：首次健康激活、每次成功
  重连与每次主备切换都原子提交（temp 文件 fsync 后 rename）该文件：紧凑
  UTF-8 JSON、非 ASCII 原样、无末尾换行，键序固定
  `schema_version,provider_id,target_provider_id,generation,reason,phase`
  （依次为固定整数 2、非空字符串、null/非空字符串、从 1 递增的正整数、
  `initial`/`reconnect`/`failover`、`ready`/`switching`）；旧
  schema_version 1 文件（仅 `schema_version,provider_id,generation`
  三字段）视作 `ready`。切换（故障转移
  或改换 provider_id 的重连）先原子写 `switching`（旧 ID、目标 ID、原
  代），再写 `ready`（目标 ID、null、代+1）；重启或任一进程读到
  `switching` 时重验目标：健康即完成该切换（写 `ready`、代+1），否则保
  留文件原样并固定 `503`。文件缺失由首次健康激活创建（generation 1）；
  损坏或字段非法时，提供者调用与重连一律按固定文案 `503` 且绝不改写该
  文件。仅健康候选能在跨进程排他锁（`provider-state.lock`，与进程内门
  共用 5 秒门限）下互斥递增 generation；失败或提交前崩溃保留旧代。提交
  后各进程下次调用重建当前配置，所得 `provider_id` 不符或不健康则
  `503`（链配置时改为触发故障转移）且零副作用。
- CLI：`provider status --operator O`、
  `provider reconnect --operator O` 与
  `provider switchover --operator O --provider-id P`，成功输出同序单行
  JSON；`400→2`、`503→1`，成功 `0`。status 在提供者不可用时仍以退出
  `0` 返回 `{"provider_id":null,"status":"unavailable"}`。

## 幂等操作

- HTTP 的 rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate/encrypt（CLI：
  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`；CLI `encrypt` 维持非幂等、
  无此头）必须携带**单一** `Idempotency-Key` 头（前四个 CLI 必填
  `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个 `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、
  重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写
  审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
  排他锁串行化。encrypt 的规范化体对明文/AAD 只保存键控不透明承诺，绝不保存
  明文或 AAD 本身。
- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
  不占用该键。
- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。变更类成功为
  `201` succeeded，只读 encrypt 成功为 `200` succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409`
  conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为 failed（保留原状态码）。并发
  同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回 `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待
  方不写任何东西。
- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原
  `200`/`201`/`403`/`404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随
  事件持久化，严格重放）；变更类操作事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文
  件、提供者句柄与标记由 outbox/provision 恢复回滚；只读 encrypt 事件未入帐
  时保持 `pending`（信封无法在无请求的情况下重建，故绝不臆造终态），由同键
  HTTP 重试在同一 `operation_id` 下恰好再执行一次。不重复记账（账本按
  event_id 去重），不误判。
- **operation 工件镜像**：rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 以及 HTTP
  encrypt 在幂等键绑定记录耐久**之后**、首次调用提供者**之前**，原子创建
  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`（0600、temp 文件 fsync 后 rename；
  非幂等入口与未绑定请求不创建该目录；CLI `encrypt` 为非幂等入口不创建）。
  镜像是一次尝试全部耐久工件的交叉索引，记录租户、操作者、路径、规范化请求
  体、`kind`/审计动作、完整写集（rotate/import/encrypt 为该 key_id，batch
  为全部 key_id，restore 为全部新建 key_id 及是否含策略）、阶段
  （`bound`→`provisioning`→`staged`→`committed`/`rolled_back`）、
  `provisions/<id>.json` 引用（batch 另引用 `batch-rotations/<id>.json`，空
  restore 另记录其 `restore-empty-*` 标记）以及每铸一个句柄即登记的新句柄
  `provider_id`/`handle`；只读 encrypt 不铸句柄、无 journal/snapshot，镜像始
  终停在 `bound`，事件耐久且无残留证据即清除。镜像与 journal 条目同步落盘，
  二者永不矛盾。请求到达终态后：事件确认且 action/tenant/operation 一致、写
  集文件拥有全部新句柄且 journal/snapshot 已清，才删镜像并保留新版本（encrypt
  另核对暂存信封命名写集 key 且版本存在）；事件未入账时，变更类先由 outbox
  恢复幂等删除全部新句柄并恢复可信旧写集，证据清零才删镜像；encrypt 则保持
  pending 并保留镜像作为待重试线索。账本不可读、提交不确定（同 id 事件
  action/tenant 不符）、镜像缺失/损坏、镜像与 `operations/<id>.json` 绑定不
  一致、引用缺失/不一致或 batch snapshot 损坏时，**保留整组证据**（镜像、标
  记、journal、snapshot 与句柄），不猜测回滚也不暴露未提交 current：该
  operation 保持 `pending`，请求/重启返回 `500`/`503` 等待下次重试。无镜像的
  旧 journal 与旧 restore 标记沿用原有恢复规则，镜像从不强制存在。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。

## 策略

- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/encrypt/decrypt/audit`，单条内
  重复去重；`effect` 为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同
  subject+effect+无序动作集的重复规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。

## 审计

- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/
  encrypt/decrypt/audit/tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/
  policy_delete`，`outcome` 为 `success/rejected`。信封加密/解密事件只含
  元数据（无 plaintext、aad、envelope、数据密钥或私钥）；幂等 HTTP encrypt
  每个终态至多一条 `event_id=operation_id,action=encrypt` 事件（成功 200 与
  绑定后拒绝都随操作重放，绝不重复记账），非幂等 CLI/decrypt 每次请求各记一
  条；策略拒绝写一条对应 `encrypt`/`decrypt` 的 rejected 事件（携带 key_id），
  成功写对应 action 的 success 事件。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者
  `key_id` 均为 null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批
  至多一条 `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。

## 命令行

所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。

```bash
# 密钥
python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
# 信封加密/解密（plaintext/aad 为 base64，version 缺省 current）
python -m keymgr encrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
                          --plaintext <base64> [--aad <base64>] [--version 1] \
                          --operator alice
python -m keymgr decrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
                          --envelope <keymgr-envelope-v1-base64> [--aad <base64>] \
                          --operator alice
python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
# KMS/HSM 健康检查与无中断重连（全局，无 --tenant-id）
python -m keymgr provider status    --operator alice
python -m keymgr provider reconnect --operator alice
```

## KMS/HSM 提供者

- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
  幂等。另可实现可选 `health()`（无参、返回 `bool`）：缺少视为健康，非
  `bool`/抛异常视为不可用。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`
  （CLI `1`），固定文案
  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
- `KEYMGR_PROVIDER_CHAIN` 为主备链：逗号分隔的 `local`/`module:factory`
  项，项唯一且建厂所得 `provider_id` 唯一（重复即整链不可用）。首次激活
  选首个健康项；活动实例不健康时按上节规则故障转移到首个健康备项，主项
  恢复后不自动回切，reconnect 才按链序重选。链配置时“本地提供者是否活

  旧记录接管等门控不会因此导入任何 module:factory 提供者。
- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。

## 持久化与限制

- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal

  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复
  依据 journal 头校验账本中同 id 事件确属本次操作（动作、租户一致）才判定已
  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量

1	"""Idempotent operation records for mutating key endpoints.
2	
3	The rotate / import / restore endpoints accept an ``Idempotency-Key`` header
4	(CLI: ``--idempotency-key``). One key, scoped by tenant and operator, is bound
5	to exactly one operation: its canonical request (path and normalized body) and
6	its outcome (HTTP status and response body). A retried request presenting the
7	same binding replays the stored status/response without any side effect; the
8	same key with a different binding is a conflict that names the original
9	``operation_id``.
10	
11	Each operation has an RFC 4122 UUID4 ``operation_id`` (used verbatim as the
12	operation's audit ``event_id``) and moves through ``pending`` ->
13	``succeeded`` / ``failed`` / ``conflict`` / ``timed_out``. Records persist in
14	``operations/<operation_id>.json`` (0600); the idempotency-key index
15	``operations/index.json`` maps a scoped key to its operation_id. All
16	read-modify-write of the index is serialized by one in-process lock plus an
17	exclusive ``fcntl`` lock on ``operations.lock``, so two concurrent requests
18	carrying the same key (across threads or processes) can never both execute:
19	exactly one begins, the other finds the pending binding and waits.
20	
21	A process that dies while an operation is pending is repaired on the next
22	open via :meth:`OperationStore.recover_pending`: when the operation's audit
23	event (named after the operation_id) reached the ledger the operation
24	committed and the supplied resolver rebuilds its response; otherwise the
25	operation never committed and is recorded as failed. The half-finished key
26	files and provider handles themselves are reaped by the store/coordinator
27	outbox recovery, which must run first.
28	"""
29

31	import json
32	import os
33	import tempfile

44	# Operation states.
45	STATUS_PENDING = "pending"

62	def is_valid_idempotency_key(value) -> bool:
63	    """Validate an Idempotency-Key: 1-128 chars from the unreserved ASCII set.
64	
65	    The permitted alphabet is RFC 3986 unreserved characters:
66	    ``A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -``.
67	    """
68	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not 1 <= len(value) <= 128:
69	        return False
70	    for ch in value:
71	        if not (
72	            "A" <= ch <= "Z"
73	            or "a" <= ch <= "z"
74	            or "0" <= ch <= "9"
75	            or ch in "._~-"
76	        ):
77	            return False
78	    return True

81	def state_for_http_status(http_status: int) -> str:
82	    """Map a terminal response's HTTP status to its operation state.
83	
84	    200 and 201 are successes; an explicit request conflict (409) is the
85	    "conflict" state. Every other terminal refusal (400/403/404) or backend
86	    failure (500/503) records as "failed". A crash-recovered operation whose
87	    audit event is durable therefore lands in the same state the original
88	    request would have, including a reconstructed rejection.
89	    """
90	    if http_status in (200, 201):
91	        return STATUS_SUCCEEDED
92	    if http_status == 409:
93	        return STATUS_CONFLICT
94	    return STATUS_FAILED

101	    "import": "import",
102	    "restore": "import",
103	    "encrypt": "encrypt",

107	def _event_matches_operation(record: "OperationRecord", event) -> bool:
108	    """Whether a durable ledger event is THIS operation's commit event.
109	
110	    Crash recovery decides committed-vs-not purely from the ledger, but the
111	    event id alone is not enough: a durable event whose tenant, action or
112	    outcome disagrees with the operation's recorded context belongs to a
113	    different mutation that happens to carry the same id, and must not
114	    finalize this operation either way. The tenant must always match the
115	    operation record; the action/outcome are checked against the staged
116	    terminal audit descriptor when one exists, else the event must be a
117	    success whose action fits the operation kind (when the kind is known).
118	    """
119	    if event.tenant_id != record.tenant_id:
120	        return False
121	    details = record.details or {}
122	    audit_desc = details.get("audit")
123	    if isinstance(audit_desc, dict):
124	        action = audit_desc.get("action")
125	        if isinstance(action, str) and action and event.action != action:
126	            return False
127	        outcome = audit_desc.get("outcome")
128	        if isinstance(outcome, str) and outcome and event.outcome != outcome:
129	            return False
130	        return True
131	    if event.outcome != "success":
132	        return False
133	    expected = _KIND_ACTIONS.get(details.get("kind"))
134	    if expected is not None and event.action != expected:
135	        return False
136	    return True

139	def normalize_body(body: Optional[dict]) -> str:

141	
142	    Keys are sorted and compact separators are used so bodies that differ only
143	    in key order or whitespace bind as the same request; a semantically
144	    different body binds differently and therefore conflicts.
145	    """
146	    return json.dumps(
147	        body if body is not None else {},
148	        sort_keys=True,
149	        separators=(",", ":"),
150	        ensure_ascii=False,
151	    )

302	    def _path_for(self, operation_id: str) -> str:

305	    def _locked(self):
306	        """Take the in-process lock and the cross-process fcntl lock."""
307	        self._index_lock.acquire()
308	        if fcntl is None:  # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX platforms
309	            return -1

480	            index["bindings"][scope] = operation_id
481	            self._write_atomic(self._index_path, index)
482	            return BeginResult("new", record)
483	        finally:
484	            self._unlocked(fd)
485	
486	    def await_terminal(
487	        self, record: OperationRecord, timeout: float = LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS
488	    ) -> OperationRecord:
489	        """Wait for a concurrently-owned operation to finish.
490	
491	        Polls the record file until the owner records a terminal state, or
492	        until ``timeout`` elapses, in which case the still-pending record is
493	        returned (the caller answers timed_out without mutating it).
494	        """
495	        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
496	        current = record
497	        while not current.is_terminal():
498	            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
499	            if remaining <= 0:
500	                return current
501	            time.sleep(min(_POLL_SECONDS, remaining))
502	            refreshed = self._read_record(current.operation_id)
503	            if refreshed is None:
504	                continue
505	            current = refreshed
506	        return current
507	
508	    def update_details(self, record: OperationRecord, details: dict) -> None:
509	        """Persist recovery facts on a still-pending owned operation.
510	
511	        ``details`` is merged into the already-persisted context rather than
512	        replacing it, so a terminal rejection never erases the operation kind,
513	        the exact key_id rule or other facts recorded before the business
514	        check ran. Written before the mutation runs, so a crash after the
515	        audit commit but before :meth:`finish` can still rebuild the committed
516	        response from durable context alone.
517	        """
518	        merged = dict(record.details or {})
519	        merged.update(details)
520	        record.details = merged
521	        fd = self._locked()
522	        try:
523	            self._write_record(record)
524	        finally:
525	            self._unlocked(fd)
526	
527	    def stage_terminal(
528	        self,
529	        record: OperationRecord,
530	        http_status: int,
531	        response: dict,
532	        audit: Optional[dict] = None,
533	    ) -> None:
534	        """Durably persist the exact terminal result *before* the event append.
535	
536	        The staged ``result`` (HTTP status plus the complete error/success
537	        response body) and optional ``audit`` descriptor are merged into the
538	        operation context and fsynced to the record file. Once the subsequent
539	        audit append lands, crash recovery replays this exact status/response
540	        verbatim -- never re-evaluating the policy, re-reading the object or
541	        re-decrypting the bundle. A crash before the append leaves both the
542	        stage and the event uncommitted and the operation is later finalized
543	        as failed(500).
544	        """
545	        details = dict(record.details or {})
546	        details["result"] = {
547	            "http_status": http_status,
548	            "response": response,
549	        }
550	        # Explicit terminal status mirror; also read by the legacy fallback
551	        # resolver for records predating the staged "result".
552	        details["terminal"] = http_status
553	        if audit is not None:
554	            details["audit"] = audit
555	        self.update_details(record, details)
556	
557	    def finish(
558	        self,
559	        record: OperationRecord,
560	        status: str,
561	        http_status: int,
562	        response: dict,
563	    ) -> None:
564	        """Persist the terminal state/response of an owned operation."""
565	        from datetime import datetime, timezone
566	
567	        record.status = status
568	        record.http_status = http_status
569	        record.response = response
570	        record.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
571	        fd = self._locked()
572	        try:
573	            self._write_record(record)
574	        finally:
575	            self._unlocked(fd)
576	
577	    def finalize_durable(
578	        self,
579	        record: OperationRecord,
580	        http_status: int,
581	        response: dict,
582	        audit: Optional[dict] = None,
583	    ) -> None:
584	        """Stage a terminal result, then make the audit event the commit point.
585	
586	        Used by the read-only idempotent encrypt, which has no key-file
587	        outbox: the exact terminal status/response (and the audit descriptor
588	        naming the operation's event) are fsynced to the operation record
589	        first, then the single ledger event named after the operation_id is
590	        appended durably. The append's event_id dedupe makes a retry
591	        idempotent. Only once the append returns does the caller finish the
592	        operation and release the envelope; a crash before the append leaves
593	        the operation pending with neither event nor envelope answer, so a
594	        restart/retry re-runs the encryption exactly once and never answers
595	        from an uncommitted stage. Raises ``LedgerError`` if the commit point
596	        itself cannot be reached (the response is then withheld).
597	        """
598	        self.stage_terminal(record, http_status, response, audit=audit)
599	        desc = audit or {}
600	        self.audit.append(
601	            self.audit.new_event(
602	                record.tenant_id,
603	                desc.get("action"),
604	                desc.get("key_id"),
605	                desc.get("outcome"),
606	                event_id=record.operation_id,
607	            )
608	        )
609	
610	    def get(
611	        self, operation_id: str, tenant_id: str, operator_id: str
612	    ) -> Optional[OperationRecord]:
613	        """Return an operation visible to exactly one tenant and operator.
614	
615	        An unknown id, a malformed id, or an operation owned by another tenant
616	        or another operator all return None so existence never leaks.
617	        """
618	        try:
619	            if uuid.UUID(operation_id).version != 4:
620	                return None
621	        except (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError):
622	            return None
623	        record = self._read_record(operation_id)
624	        if record is None:
625	            return None
626	        if record.tenant_id != tenant_id or record.operator_id != operator_id:
627	            return None
628	        return record
629	
630	    # -- crash recovery ----------------------------------------------------
631	    def recover_pending(
632	        self,
633	        resolve_committed: Optional[
634	            Callable[["OperationRecord", object], "tuple[int, dict]"]
635	        ] = None,
636	        is_parked: Optional[Callable[[str], bool]] = None,
637	    ) -> None:
638	        """Finish operations left pending by a crashed process.
639	
640	        Must run *after* the key-store and restore outbox recovery, so the
641	        ledger already reflects every half-committed mutation. For each
642	        pending operation: when its event reached the ledger the operation
643	        is durable and the terminal status/response persisted *with the
644	        rejection/success context* (``details["result"]``) are replayed
645	        verbatim -- the policy, the current object state and the (possibly no
646	        longer decryptable) bundle are never consulted again, so a later
647	        policy/state change cannot turn a 403 into a 404/409 or rewrite the
648	        first response; only when no result was staged (older records) does
649	        ``resolve_committed(record, event)`` rebuild a best-effort
650	        projection. When the event never reached the ledger the operation
651	        never committed and is recorded as a 500 failure (the outbox/
652	        provision recovery has already removed its half-written files and
653	        minted handles).
654	        """
655	        try:
656	            names = os.listdir(self.dir_path)
657	        except OSError:
658	            return
659	        for name in names:
660	            if not name.endswith(".json") or name == _INDEX_NAME:
661	                continue
662	            operation_id = name[:-5]
663	            record = self._read_record(operation_id)
664	            if record is None or record.status != STATUS_PENDING:
665	                continue
666	            # The artifact-mirror settlement runs first: a surviving mirror
667	            # whose evidence is incomplete/inconsistent (unreadable ledger,
668	            # uncertain commit, corrupt/missing basis) keeps the operation
669	            # pending for a later open rather than guessing a terminal.
670	            if is_parked is not None and is_parked(operation_id):
671	                continue
672	            event = None
673	            try:
674	                event = self.audit.get_event(record.event_id)
675	            except Exception:
676	                # Cannot decide right now; leave it for a later open.
677	                continue
678	            if event is not None and not _event_matches_operation(
679	                record, event
680	            ):
681	                # A durable event carries this operation's id but is not the
682	                # operation's own event (tenant/action/outcome mismatch): the
683	                # id collides with a different mutation, so the operation can
684	                # be finalized neither as committed nor as failed. Leave it
685	                # pending for operator/startup resolution rather than
686	                # replaying a response the durable fact does not support.
687	                continue
688	            if event is not None:
689	                details = record.details or {}
690	                staged = details.get("result")
691	                if (
692	                    isinstance(staged, dict)
693	                    and isinstance(staged.get("http_status"), int)
694	                    and isinstance(staged.get("response"), dict)
695	                ):

697	                    # byte-for-byte regardless of the current policy/state.
698	                    http_status = int(staged["http_status"])
699	                    response = staged["response"]
700	                else:

702	                    if details_now.get("kind") == "encrypt":
703	                        # The event is durable but the exact 200 envelope was
704	                        # not staged (a scene the encrypt flow never produces):
705	                        # the envelope cannot be reconstructed without the
706	                        # request, so never fabricate one. Keep the op pending
707	                        # for an identical retry, which dedupes on the durable
708	                        # event and re-seals under the same operation_id.
709	                        continue

711	                    # committed before the result was staged.
712	                    http_status, response = 201, {
713	                        "operation_id": record.operation_id
714	                    }
715	                    if resolve_committed is not None:
716	                        try:
717	                            http_status, response = resolve_committed(
718	                                record, event
719	                            )
720	                        except Exception:
721	                            http_status, response = 201, {
722	                                "operation_id": record.operation_id
723	                            }
724	                self.finish(
725	                    record,
726	                    state_for_http_status(http_status),

734	                    # became durable: no key/handle/outbox exists, and the
735	                    # sealed envelope cannot be rebuilt at startup (the
736	                    # request plaintext/aad are deliberately not stored). Keep
737	                    # the operation PENDING with the envelope hidden; an

740	                    # from durable facts. Never guess a failed(500) terminal.
